adjudicator: Claude (Fable 5), WP E4 Score/Adjudication session 2026-07-11, per the review-delegation standing instruction (2026-06-12)
scope: every (star, ftp_mb) row with E4 verdict alias/miss vs its role truth (9 stars: 7 science, 2 control_antijoin). Evidence = folds/<uid>_ftp_mb.png + e4_adjudication_evidence.json (PDM theta, fold chi2_red, 6-method consensus, ftp_mb top-5 peaks, mags).
post_adjudication_rule: lawful stars get adjudicated_period = the ftp_mb recovered period (the 7.5-yr ZTF consensus period); any method whose best_freq matches it (same AND criterion: frac<1% AND |df|*T<0.5, exact-or-harmonic) is credited post-adjudication. The failure star credits no method. Non-queued (star,method) cells keep their pre-adjudication verdicts -- only the ftp_mb queue was adjudicated, per the E4 brief.

categories.truth_period_precision: catalog truth period too imprecise to phase 7.5 yr of ZTF data; recovered period folds decisively cleaner; no independent catalog confirms the truth value
categories.chen_truth_error_confirmed_by_gaia: recovered period agrees with the INDEPENDENT Gaia DR3 SOS period within phase coherence while Chen's disagrees; Chen truth error/precision, not a method failure
categories.gaia_truth_precision: control star (truth = Gaia); unanimous 6-method ZTF consensus period folds decisively cleaner than the Gaia fold; Gaia DR3 ~34-month baseline cannot pin 7.5-yr phase
categories.blazhko_or_period_change: excess fold scatter + resolved close sideband and/or mutually consistent catalog truths that both disagree with the full-baseline period: the star's period is modulated/drifting, so a single fixed truth period is ill-defined at this coherence
categories.photometric_depth_failure: no coherent signal present in the ZTF photometry even at the truth period; all methods lock onto window systematics; genuine failure (of the data, charged to every method)
